payload.reason: The evidence indicates that ARAML significantly improves the stability and performance of text generation compared to other GANs and baselines.

claims.text: ARAML outperforms state-of-the-art text GANs with a more stable training process.
Experiments show that ARAML performs significantly better than other baselines in all cases, indicating enhanced performance metrics.
ARAML achieves lower training variance and better performance on three text generation tasks compared to several state-of-the-art GAN baselines.
The model does not fall into mode collapse and generates more diverse sentences, as indicated by Self-BLEU metrics.
